只使用家具币，不使用虹卡或黑卡。已有图纸不重复买；图纸不可购买或余额不足时整单不: Only Furniture Coins are used - never Rainbow or Black Cards. Blueprints you already own are not bought again; if any blueprint is unbuyable or the balance is short, the whole order is skipped. Nothing is charged until you confirm the preview.
购买后重新打开游戏内的一键家具合成页面。: After purchasing, reopen the one-click furniture synthesis page in game.
紫色协合勋绩属于公会公共余额；蓝色联合绩点属于自己的背包，两者分别补充。公共资源: Purple Co-op Merits belong to the shared guild pool; blue Joint Points belong to your own inventory, and they are topped up separately. Only the Commander and Vice Commander can move pool resources or upgrade; regular members can top up their own Joint Points. Enter the game first.
使用已有经验升一级: Spend stored EXP to level up once
补充每次1–10000，各项操作共用指挥局10秒冷却。经验不会自动升级：经验足够: Top-ups range 1-10,000 each and share a 10-second bureau cooldown. EXP does not auto-level: once you have enough, either pick "Spend stored EXP to level up once" or use Guild > Info > Manage > Upgrade in game. Guild level-ups award Beacon Boost Points; at max level every 32,000 EXP converts to 20 points.
